about: Two-sentence notes for the overlay where data/mapping.json's note runs longer or would state an unconfirmed claim; read by scripts/produce.py. Each condenses the mapping's own note and adds nothing to it.

notes.Proposition 5.2: [L] states the same conclusion, one scaling with all-arity, all-degree comparison to the free correlators, as vanishing against bounded compactly supported tests, which is equivalent to [M]'s L^1_loc form by the argument [M] gives after the proposition. Its hypotheses are packaged inputs (Stations, DimAbove, hierarchies, Ordered) rather than the section's standing assumptions.
notes.Lemma 11.4: No single declaration states the lemma: uniqueness and nonempty eligibility come from Axial.viable, the tag sum from StepData.chosen and the kernel normalization from StepData.density_total. [L]'s uniqueness holds for all cutoffs below a threshold and eligibility for any factor >= 16.
notes.Lemma 12.5: allleg gives the k>=3 case and bothleg the k=2 case, with eta<=sigma and K depending only on arity and sigma, and exponential decay of Fourier coefficients is the Vane part of Firm. Transversality and f = delta...delta g are stated at real momenta only, which for analytic f and g is equivalent to [M]'s identity on the strip.
notes.Lemma 13.14: [L] encodes [M]'s classes A, I, R and its trajectories with a Team per level, Top for I, Passage for R, and Circle as the trajectory. Restriction closure and the retained bounds are not part of Circle, so the correspondence is by role.
notes.Lemma 13.17: [L] proves the multilinear expansion with ||T_k|| <= fee^k c (matching 4e/(rR) at p=R/2) from the coefficient-budget hypothesis Often/Scout, and no declaration states it from [M]'s stencil hypothesis. [M] also prints that the T_k are symmetric, which [L] does not state; the closest declaration is YM.FullVolume.Amp.Often.gardenL.
notes.Eq (14.2): [M] bounds the ratio of integrals by exp(V[...]) <= e^{V q_m} at every level; [L] bounds the exponent bill by the number of sites times treasury, and treasury by fiat for large m, with 2E_m + eps_for as 2(allowance + loopsPrice) + forcedAllowance. The integral-ratio form itself was not found.
notes.Eq (14.44): The bound's shape, the subtraction of the one-point product and the roles of T, Z, U agree. [L] fixes T, Z, U as explicit functions of its parameters, while [M] takes them as given bounds.
notes.Eq (15.1): [M] prints that S_n is C^infty on Conf_n and that every derivative of f_{P(k),v} converges locally uniformly to the derivative of S_n. [L] proves smoothness only for a separate table T that agrees with S on generic points (Arrives.serves) and only value-level convergence of the volume tables (RawLimits.volume); no declaration states the convergence of derivatives.
notes.Lemma 15.1: The extraction, the ordered convergence of smears, persistence under refinement and the eventual inclusion of compact sets in NoHit are in [L] (crops, first_surface, RawLimits, copy_down). [M] also prints that S_n is C^infty and that all derivatives of f_{P(k),v} converge locally uniformly; [L] proves only value-level convergence, and smoothness only for a distinct table T equal to S on generic points.
notes.Eq (15.6): [M] states the two identities pointwise for kappa, tau on V_d; [L] states them pointwise for the quotient maps rise, deriv on F_d = Label/Null and for the lifted maps only in smeared form (Wakes), and the pointwise form follows by composing with the projection. [L] obtains the maps under the Spans hypothesis, which [M] derives from its relay lemmas.
notes.Lemma 15.3: Each claim has a counterpart (Wakes, Inclusions, Derivatives, Beam.carries, Table.unit), conditional on RelayCosts, Detector and the rank hypotheses, which [M] supplies from Lemmas E2.6-E2.10. The sentence on convergence along every ultrafilter containing the ordered tails has no standalone statement: [L] refines the order instead.
notes.Eq (16.3): [L] proves the two laws (beacon_signal) for every scalar multiple c of the stress, and [M] prints the case c = -1, since T^Max = -polStress. [L]'s generator is the rewiring by the rotation derivation, which [M] calls the derivative of R^Max(e^{tK}).
notes.Lemma 16.1: No single declaration states the lemma: the table laws are hierarchy, scheme_derives, phase_orientation and gear_laws, strict positivity is detects, the stress line is line_dim with law and lit_ne normalized by beacon_signal, and the two-point value is scalar_pair. Combining the line facts is a one-line step.
notes.Definition 18.11: [L]'s coherent vector has the sector phase i^k in front of v_h^{tensor k}/sqrt(k!), which [M]'s E(h) lacks and [M]'s proof of Lemma 18.12 absorbs as a common sector unitary. The other ingredients (v_h, normalization, comparison conditions, psi_U) agree.
notes.Lemma 18.12: Under the trace law (EuclideanAsymptotic, A>0), [L] proves it for every bounded self-adjoint P fixing U H and with open Q, W, which is more than [M] prints; the ball version takes P = id in regions_excludes. Coherent vectors carry the sector phase i^k, which [M]'s proof absorbs into U.
notes.Lemma 19.16: The thresholds precede the measure, weight and maps in both declarations, and the three bounds B*Q, B*Q*e_D and B*Q_{m+1} are the CoefIntegral fields ask and dual and the JointEstimate bound. The coefficient part takes the nested scales as Tapered r 1 s and the geometry a.e. in Accept.
notes.Lemma 14.12: Unclear: the judge did not settle whether the Spent budget of Unbilled.realizes gives the printed (2B_i+1)^4 bound at every level, so no relation is claimed.
